moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio horizontal-scrub, written here): Viewport 248x100; 5 cards 100x76 r10 every 112 px. Track x 0 → −324 px linear over 0.3-1.7 s, hold 0.4 s, back to 0 linear 2.1-3.5 s. A vertical scroll thumb at left (30 px in a 100 px rail) and a progress bar below move in sync. Params: travel (324 px) · duration (1.4 s) · hold (0.4 s) · ease (none).
